title: The Scarecrow
description: It used to scare bird from crops, but now it's here to scare the player
body:
The Scarecrow was once a simple tool to keep birds away from fields, but now it has come to life. At night, the Scarecrow awakens, silently stalking players and freezing water in its presence. It keeps its distance, watching from afar, but staring at it for too long or getting too close can make the Scarecrow aggressive or let it vanishes.
When enraged, the Scarecrow’s face starts burning. It can Break blocks, summoning minions, and using attacks to blind or ignite players. If its health falls low, soul flames surround it, making it stronger and more resistant. Even death isn't the end, as a new Scarecrow may emerge elsewhere...

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>



► [OLD] What is my console spaming?

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

► [OLD] Why can't I summon a mob?

Spawning Conditions determine which conditions must be met in order to spawn certain mobs. Some mobs only spawn above Y level 60. Some below. Most mobs can only spawn in the overworld than in other dimensions.

► Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.
For example: Version 1.19.2 doesn't have the feature of shield, better structure generation or custom villagers, but Version 1.20.1 does have them.

► Why does the Scarecrow disappear?

Looking directly at the Scarecrow can result in various events causing it to despawn. She can place a pumpkin, spawn mobs, jump scare a player or become aggressive.

► Why does my Scarecrow not work during the night?

If you find a Scarecrow on a field, you have found the Field structure where you can find a Soulless Scarecrow that has no AI and therefore does nothing except stay still, even at night.

</details>



![The Scarecrow](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/df70f011081ffef4902cf957060903e7ea5f6812.png)

The Scarecrow remains motionless during the day, but when night falls, it awakens. When it becomes active, lightning can appear in the sky or you will be jumpscared with a low chance. It follows the player and observes him, but maintains its distance from him. Water freezes near the Scarecrow. Getting too close or staring at it for too long causes it to vanish, spawning spiders, crows, or pumplins, leaving pumpkins, or triggering a rare jumpscare. More often, it turns aggressive, while its face starts burning. The Scarecrow can destroy wood, glass, crops, and cobblestone, and its attacks may blind or set players on fire. It summons spiders, crows or pumplins for support, and when its health drops below 80, soul flames surround it, boosting its strength and resistance. If defeated, another Scarecrow may appear elsewhere. There can also spawn Soulless, passive Scarecrows in field structures, but remaining motionless even if night falls.
